1.w: And to Moses He said, “Come up to YHWH, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy from the elders of Israel, and worship from a distance.

2.w: And Moses alone shall draw near to YHWH, and they shall not draw near, and the people shall not go up with him.”

3.w: And Moses came and recounted to the people all the words of YHWH and all the ordinances. And all the people answered [with] one voice and said, “All the words that YHWH has spoken, we will do.”

4.w: And Moses wrote all the words of YHWH. And he rose early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, and two [and] ten pillars, according to the two [and] ten tribes of Israel.

5.w: And he sent young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed sacrifices of peace to YHWH, young bulls.

6.w: And Moses took half the blood and put [it] in basins, and half the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

7.w: And he took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud in the ears of the people. And they said, “All that YHWH has spoken we will do, and we will listen.”

8.w: And Moses took the blood and sprinkled [it] on the people, and he said, “Behold, the blood of the covenant which YHWH has cut with you⁺ according to all these words.”

9.w: And Moses went up, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy from the elders of Israel,

10.w: and they saw the God of Israel, and under His feet [was] like the work of a pavement of sapphire, and like the substance of the heavens for purity.

11.w: And on the nobles of the sons of Israel He did not stretch out His hand; and they saw God, and they ate and they drank.

12.w: And YHWH said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain, and be there, and I will give to you the tablets of stone, and the law, and the command that I have written, that you may teach them.”

13.w: And Moses arose, and Joshua his assistant, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.

14.w: And to the elders he said, “Remain for us in this [place], until that we return to you⁺. And behold, Aaron and Hur [are] with you⁺. Whoever [is] a master of words shall come near to them.”

15.w: And Moses went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

16.w: And the glory of YHWH dwelt on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And He called to Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.

17.w: And the sight of the glory of YHWH [was] like a consuming fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the sons of Israel.

18.w: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and he went up to the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
